name: Developer Tool, CLI & Utility Contract
description: Master prompt structure for building CLI tools, libraries, microservices, SDKs, and scripts.

required_sections.heading: Tool Objective & Operational Scope
required_sections.description: Tool command surface, inputs, outputs, and performance requirements.

required_sections.heading: Command Syntax, Interface & Subsystem Design
required_sections.description: Flag parsing, I/O streams, exit codes, and core processing logic.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Functional test harness, edge case handling, and zero placeholder code.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Deterministic command line contract, JSON schema, or SDK signature.

required_sections.heading: Self-Verification Quality Checklist
required_sections.description: Self-verification suite verifying error conditions and clean termination.

required_sections.heading: Tool Execution Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Guardrails against unintended disk/network operations and unhandled exceptions.

required_sections.heading: Documented Assumptions & Context
required_sections.description: Runtime platform, shell requirements, and dependencies.

optional_sections.heading: Packaging & Package Manager Distribution
optional_sections.out_of_scope_message: External package distribution is out of scope unless explicitly requested.

exemplars.scenario: CLI Tool / SDK Library with Test Suite
exemplars.pattern: Define argument parser flags, error codes, programmatic API interfaces, and deterministic unit tests.
